name: Aelnir Passport Photo Maker
seoTitle: Aelnir Passport Photo Maker: ID and visa photos on Android
summary: Make correctly sized ID and visa photos and printable sheets, all on your phone.
tagline: Pick a country or document, take or import a portrait, and get a framed, correctly sized photo. Nothing is uploaded.

features.title: From selfie to ID photo
features.lead: One portrait pipeline, driven by a photo specification for each document.

items.title: Choose the requirement
items.body: Pick a country or document, and the size, framing and file limits follow.

items.title: Take or import
items.body: Use the camera with guidance, or import an existing portrait.

items.title: Auto crop and background
items.body: On-device face detection frames the photo and replaces the background, with manual adjustment.

items.title: Exact file size
items.body: Export at the right dimensions, DPI and a target file size, with no location data.

items.title: Printable sheets
items.body: Lay several copies out on a sheet, as a PDF or an image.

items.title: Honest checks
items.body: A checklist to help match the requirement. Final acceptance is the issuing authority’s decision.

strip.label: Does
strip.text: Crop · Background · Size · DPI · Print sheet · Checklist

note.label: Free, with ads
note.title: Your face never leaves your phone
note.body: Aelnir Passport Photo Maker is free and supported by ads. Face detection, background replacement and export all run on your device.

studioProof.hard: One engine driven by versioned photo specifications, not a set of country screens.
